  Thanks for the PR! A few prompts to make review faster:

## What

<!-- One or two sentences. What does this PR change? -->

## Why

<!-- What problem does it solve, or what use case does it unlock?
     If there's a linked issue, reference it: "Closes #42" -->

## How to verify

<!-- Steps a reviewer can follow to confirm the change works.
     Screenshots help for visual changes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] If this touches `skills/` or `boilerplate/`, the example still demonstrates security best practices (capability check, nonce, sanitize, escape, prepared SQL)
- [ ] If this changes a component's HTML output, related tests or docs are updated
- [ ] If this adds a new public API, `CONTRIBUTING.md` or the relevant README has been updated
- [ ] PR targets the `dev` branch (not `main`)

<!-- Anything else the reviewer should know? -->
